correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the entire 743-face augmented chain complex, obtains exact binary boundary ranks, and uses Euler characteristic to prove degree-3 rational homology has rank seven only. Every one of all 384 automorphisms has its trace reconstructed by two independent exact finite methods and compared against the 3+4 signed representation formula; all 20 conjugacy classes, translation Fourier multiplicities and weight-three stabilizer signs are also checked. Exterior-cube trace identity and semisimple rational finite-group theory yield an actual representation isomorphism. Script rerun from actual packaged source completed successfully. The proof is exactly for Q4 and does not extrapolate.

originality.rationale: The full 384-element B4 character, its precise 3+4 irreducible decomposition, and rational symmetry-quotient consequence are neither stated nor implied by the previously published same-object ordinary 7-sphere homotopy type, nor by nearby but different-complex symmetry theorems. value.rationale: The exact full-group character is a natural nontrivial equivariant invariant of the canonical four-cube/toroidal-grid independence complex, refining a previously available nonequivariant seven-sphere classification. It explains the 3+4 irreducible split, classifies all 384 symmetry traces, and yields distinct rational quotient behavior for translations versus the full cube group. The result is sufficiently structural despite the single finite graph because it computes a complete natural symmetry invariant and is not a narrow arbitrary slice.
